name: IB → option_harvester sync
description: Syncs positions, pending orders, recent trades, watchlists, and daily account balances (cash/NLV/margin) from the logged-in IB portal to the option_harvester backend — manually (Sync now), automatically right after you log into IB, or on a timer. Sync now runs EVERYTHING in dependency order (pull → greeks → IB 30-day IV → exact margin → conid/underlying re-resolve → OH push + read-back), so nothing on the dashboard is left from an older run; Quick sync is the fast pull alone (positions, orders, trades, watchlists, balances, greeks) and survives switching tabs; the auto and login syncs re-measure them too whenever the IB tab is the one on screen, so the deltas the dashboard gates on stay current. A separate Deep sync runs the heavy passes — greeks and exact maintenance margin (what-if), IB's own 30-day implied vol for every tracked underlying (field 7283, the IV column on an IB watchlist row), conid re-resolve, and the true underlying conid for held option-only names — which need the IB tab kept in the foreground. Reports each run to the /sync log. Dev capture for building new parsers.
